After hearing your feedback and considering the colder winter months, we've decided to take a little winter break from our monthly meetups so if you can't make November or December, you can start planning for the Spring. 

🌸 Our First Meetup of Spring! 🌸

📅 Saturday, April 17
⏰ 12:00 PM – 2:00 PM
📍 @interstatedrafthouse – Outdoor Patio

Whether you've been joining us for years or have yet to attend your first meetup, we can't wait to welcome you!

🐾 Save the date, spread the word, and get ready for a pawsome spring reunion! RSVP via link in bio! 🔗
